data.name: About_PeripheralOutputRefsDesc
data.value: Nothrim HID++ o Logitech an pothad aphas, celias, ialthad a tund, hennannen o Solaar (GPL-2.0-or-later), libratbag (MIT), LiveHaptics, OpenLogi (0BSD a MIT OR Apache-2.0), i teithad OpenLogi, keyleds (GPL-3.0-or-later), g810-led a g810-led-resources (GPL-3.0), rigdeck (GPL-3.0-or-later), OpenGHub (MIT) a g915x-heatmap (MIT), gu sarth o OpenRGB-Fixed (GPL-2.0-or-later) a HaloDaemon-plugins. IDs carf Razer a nothrim celias, hennannen o OpenRazer (GPL-2.0-or-later) a OpenRGB (GPL-2.0-or-later) a tastannen gu uncoil (GPL-3.0-or-later), OpenSynapse (AGPL-3.0-only, MIT ir hennannen), openrazer-win (GPL-2.0-or-later), sanshoku (MIT), razer_test (GPL-3.0-or-later) a razer-life (GPL-2.0-or-later), gu i theinas i curu hen maethar o Aurora (MIT) a LibreHardwareMonitor (MPL-2.0). IDs carf SteelSeries a nothrim celias, hennannen o OpenRGB a rivalcfg (WTFPL) a tastannen gu curu SignalRGB, Aerox_5 (MIT), apex-3-tkl (MIT), ApexCtl (LGPL-3.0), SteelSeriesControl (GPL-3.0), rival310-re (LGPL-3.0), Cricetus-Imperator (MIT) a Wine (LGPL-2.1-or-later). Nothrim HID LampArray, hennannen o USB-IF HID Usage Tables, i teithad Dynamic Lighting o Microsoft, a i emath în ArduinoHidForWindows a RP2040MacropadHidSample (MIT), a tastannen gu lampctl (MIT OR Apache-2.0), hid-rgb-ctl, keybackcon, mistel-lights, CaYaLight, hp-omen-35l-rgb, mac-dynamic-lighting, aura-loq a Apex3TklDynamicLighting (pân MIT), acer-predator-helios-rgb (GPL-2.0-only) a crosrgbkblight. Nothrim pothad iFeel, hennannen o iFeel, i maeth Linux an iFeel (GPL-2.0-or-later) a Logitech-iFeel-Vibration-POC, gu theinas o i maeth Linux (GPL-2.0-or-later) a i redrath bellas o i maeth MouseWare 9.80 o Logitech. I curu aphas a crui o GameSense SDK. Teithad ero, ú curu mi PadForge.

data.name: About_PortMidiRtMidiDesc
data.value: I raith WinMM nu i MIDI API iaur: edrad fen, mennad na hon, a holad hon. Hennannen o PortMidi (MIT, o Ross Bencina, Phil Burk a Roger B. Dannenberg) a RtMidi (theinas RtMidi MIT-style, o Gary P. Scavone). Teithad ero, ú curu mi PadForge.

data.name: About_AnalogKeyboardRefsDesc
